THEN EXPLAIN ABOUT LOGARITHMS

A close cousin of log2() is magnitude(), where a 10-fold increase in the input corresponds to adding 1 to the output. Both of these are in the *logarithmic family* of functions. log2() is the logarithm with a base of 2, magnitude is the logarithm with a base of 10. The shapes of these functions are identical, so either one of them can be used to the same effect.
:::
